en.name: Hao Zhou
en.intro: Investigating how neural populations organize sensory information into structured representations.
en.researchIntro: I investigate how the brain organizes sensory information into conscious experience, and how internal models and current context shape the content of that experience.
en.question1: How does sensory input become a structured conscious experience?
en.question2: How do learned structures and current context shape what we experience?
en.question3: What neural dynamics and interactions support the formation and transformation of conscious content?
en.affiliation: Center for Excellence in Brain Science and Intelligence Technology (Institute of Neuroscience), Chinese Academy of Sciences
en.projectsIntro: Four questions organize my research directions in consciousness, perception, and working memory.
en.project1Text: How does sensory input combine with internal order, relations, and task structure to form organized content representations?
en.project2Title: Neural dynamics and changes in consciousness
en.project2Text: How do the temporal dynamics of neural activity relate to changes in perception, working memory, and conscious state? This direction aims to connect behavioral measurements with neural recordings to examine these relationships.
en.project3Text: How does neural activity at different scales support the formation and organization of content? This direction aims to connect questions at population, cellular, and dendritic scales and explore relationships between levels of representation.
en.project4Text: Can changing content-related neural activity alter corresponding behavior? This direction aims to combine recording and intervention to test causal mechanisms of content organization.
en.methods1Text: Perceptual judgments and sequence working-memory tasks connect stimulus manipulations with how information is accessed, organized, and maintained.
en.methods2Text: My research draws on human high-field MRI, MEG, and EEG; macaque electrophysiology and two-photon imaging; and human stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) and single-unit recording.
en.methods3Text: Collaborative directions plan to explore voltage imaging and macaque optogenetics to extend neural measurements and causal tests.
en.methods4Text: Computational modeling is an area I am interested in developing further, using experimentally grounded questions to connect behavioral and neural data with explicit, testable predictions.
en.foundationText: Past collaborative studies used brightness and visual-illusion paradigms, time-resolved neural measurements, and spatially and depth-resolved imaging, providing methodological foundations for current research. The published COGITATE study protocol, to which I contributed, proposed preregistered tests of competing theories and multimodal measurements.
en.blogEmpty: Articles will appear here as they are published.
en.officeAddress: Institute of Neuroscience (神经所系统楼), 320 Yueyang Road, Shanghai, China

zh.pageTitle: 周浩 | 意识与工作记忆
zh.name: 周浩
zh.eyebrow: 意识 · 工作记忆 · 神经群体
zh.intro: 探索神经群体如何将感觉信息组织为具有结构的表征。
zh.researchIntro: 我研究大脑如何将感觉信息组织为意识体验，以及内部模型与当前情境如何塑造体验的内容。
zh.question1: 感觉输入如何形成有组织的意识体验？
zh.question2: 习得的内部结构与当前情境如何塑造我们体验到的内容？
zh.question3: 哪些神经动态与相互作用支持意识内容的形成和转换？
zh.preprint: 预印本 · 未经同行评审
zh.footer: 周浩 · 个人学术主页
zh.affiliation: 中国科学院脑科学与智能技术卓越创新中心（神经科学研究所）
zh.projectsIntro: 围绕意识、知觉与工作记忆，以下四个问题组织了我的研究方向。
zh.project1Text: 感觉输入如何与内部序位、关系和任务结构结合，形成有组织的内容表征？
zh.project2Text: 神经活动的时间动态如何与知觉、工作记忆及意识状态的变化相关？研究旨在结合行为测量与神经记录，考察这些变化之间的联系。
zh.project3Text: 不同尺度的神经活动如何支持内容形成与组织？这一方向旨在连接神经群体、细胞与树突尺度的研究问题，探索不同层级的表征关系。
zh.project4Title: 因果检验与内容相关行为
zh.project4Text: 改变内容相关神经活动能否改变对应行为？这一方向旨在结合记录与干预，检验内容组织的因果机制。
zh.methods1Text: 通过知觉判断与序列工作记忆任务，将刺激操控与信息的通达、组织和保持联系起来。
zh.methods2Text: 研究方法包括人类高场磁共振、脑磁图（MEG）与脑电（EEG），猕猴电生理与双光子成像，以及人类立体定向脑电（sEEG）和单细胞记录。
zh.methods3Title: 计划中的合作技术拓展
zh.methods3Text: 合作方向计划探索电压成像与猕猴光遗传技术，拓展神经活动测量与因果检验。
zh.methods4Text: 计算建模是我感兴趣、希望进一步发展的方向：从实验驱动的问题出发，将行为和神经数据与明确、可检验的预测连接起来。
zh.foundationTitle: 既往发表研究的方法基础
zh.foundationText: 既往合作研究采用了亮度与视觉错觉范式、时间分辨的神经测量、空间与深度分辨成像，为当前研究提供方法基础。参与的 COGITATE 已发表研究方案提出了预注册的竞争理论检验与跨模态测量计划。
zh.blogEmpty: 这里将陆续发布研究思考与方法笔记。
